analyst.summary: Alkyl Amines Chemicals is a specialty-chemicals producer with an excellent balance sheet (near debt-free) and strong returns (ROE ~22%, ROCE ~30%), but revenue has declined for two straight years amid industry-wide Chinese competitive pressure. The most recent quarter showed signs of bottoming out (revenue and profit both roughly flat rather than declining), and a newly approved anti-dumping duty on a key competing chemical is a genuine tailwind, with management guiding to 5-10% annual volume growth going forward. At roughly 54 times earnings, however, the price already assumes more growth than management itself is projecting, and we rate this a Sell on valuation grounds.
